title: console: a non-participant reader is offered inline edit on a record whose pending approval locks it (lockRecord: true), and the save answers 409 RECORD_LOCKED
body:
Ruled: 6422939157 · letter A (readers) · 2026-10-26T17:31Z

QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#25479 · approvals.record-page-decisions · negative[1]

## What happens

A member can read a record that has a pending `lockRecord: true` approval, but is not on the request's slate, did not submit it, and holds no override. On that record's page the console offers inline edit. The save is then refused with `409 RECORD_LOCKED`. The admin sees the same record correctly locked: no inline edit, Edit greyed, and the "Locked for approval" band. So the lock is drawn only for viewers the approvals door answers with a row.

Measured on `main` 77392e90 with the console at pin `5fef032b1ada` (built from `f0fdd45b`; see objectstack-ai/objectstack#25478). Reproduced on 3 fresh loads. The resolver below is unchanged at objectui `origin/main` `3a73c07`.

## Reproduction

1. On a stock showcase boot, as admin, mint a contributor member: `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/invite-member {"email":E,"role":"member"}`, then `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-up/email` as E, then `POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_position {"user_id":U,"position":"contributor","organization_id":ORG}`.
2. As admin, `PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_project/ID {"budget":600000}`. This opens `showcase_budget_approval` at `manager_review`.
3. As admin, `POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/MGR/approve`. The run moves to `exec_review`, and the new request row reads `lock_record: true`.
4. As the member, sign in through the console form and open `/_console/apps/showcase_app/showcase_project/record/ID`.
5. **Expected:** no inline-edit affordance (the record is locked). **Actual:** Edit is enabled, 12 fields show "Double-click to edit", and there is no lock band. Saving Health sends `PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_project/ID {"health":"yellow"}` and gets `409 RECORD_LOCKED`.

The member's own `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests?object=showcase_project&recordId=ID` answers `200 {"data":[]}`.

## Mechanism

objectui `packages/react/src/context/InlineEditContext.tsx` `resolveApprovalLock` (rule 2, objectui#12220) reads an answered approvals read with no open request as "no approval running":

```
if (openApproval) return { pending: true, locked: openApproval.locked };
if (readAnswered) return { pending: false, locked: false };
```

The approvals door serves a request only to its participants and the override actor (`plugin-approvals` request read gate; the record-reader tier is off on stock). So for a non-participant, an empty read does not mean "no approval running". The console unlocks the record, and the server then refuses the write. Nothing the non-participant can read tells them the record is locked.

The fix is a decision. One option is a lock signal a record reader can see without seeing the request. The other is the console refusing to infer "unlocked" from an empty read on an approval-enabled object. Either way the console stops offering an edit the server will refuse (objectui#2902's mislabel, for this persona).
